Instantly or Smartlead?
Hi everyone,

I've been using Instantly for a few months now and it's been solid overall. Recently looked into Smartlead since it seems to offer similar features for a bit less money. Plus I really like their "Clients/Workspace" setup, and they allow more sending volume and lead storage. Aside from that, the two platforms seem pretty similar.

The deciding factor for me is warmup quality. I'd heard Instantly's warmup wasn't great, but then I found posts here on this sub criticizing Smartlead's warmup too. Now I'm not sure what to think.

What's your experience with either one? Which do you prefer and why?

Also open to other tools if you use something different, curious what's working for people right now.

Thanks!
